description: Changes one group of the advanced settings of a campaign: protected access, the WordPress side, extra hosts and support addresses, which page the registration, thank-you, live, replay or closed view uses, the field names an email provider expects, or the wording of the privacy checkbox. Take it when access or a page address should change: "Only people from my list should get in." It needs the session, the webinar, the group, the fields and a clear yes from you, because it writes on your site and a member entry also creates a WordPress user with access. Read the current state first and say what changes. Only the group you name changes, and an unknown key refuses that whole group. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: protect webinar, access only for my list, change page, extra host, privacy checkbox

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said what may change, including any user this creates.

group.description: Which group to change. One group per call.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

settings.description: The fields of that group with their new values, as wi_get_webinar_settings names them. Only passed keys change.

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_change_advanced_settings
title: Change access, users or page routing of a webinar
